description.value:
As part of the action used to cast this power, you must land a melee weapon attack on a creature within your reach, or the power fizzles. On a hit, the target suffers the attack's usual effects, and a shimmering violet veil seals its mouth until the start of your next turn. Should it choose to speak before then, it takes 1d8 psychic damage immediately and the power ends.

Damage scales with level: at 5th level the melee attack deals an extra 1d8 psychic damage and the penalty for speaking rises to 2d8; both dice increase again at 11th and 17th level.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Dark Side Powers, At-Will
